notes: Fixes: left/graduated students no longer appear in attendance marking, staff payroll disbursement, staff leave applications, exam marks/result-card/admit-card lists, library book issue, school items sale, transport, pickup log, or fee voucher generation. Dashboard stats now refresh correctly. Delete confirmations for students, staff, and master data now warn if attendance/fee history would be orphaned. New: per-student fee discount, single-student attendance history with print, Student List status filter, configurable vouchers-per-page and voucher size for printing, and a combined family fee receipt (detailed or total-only). Fixed emoji/symbol characters not printing on early-learning worksheets.
